meta.title: Registration — Pán Prstenů
meta.description: How to sign up for Pán Prstenů 2026: registration steps, conditions, payment, cancellation.

hero.subtitle: Sign up for the Battle for Middle-earth in a few simple steps.

cta_box.body_post: , run by the Moravian LARP, z. s. association. You create your account once and then you can sign up for our individual events through it.

steps.title: 1. Fill in the form
steps.description: Online registration in our Registračka.cz system. It takes about 10 minutes. Pick your type of participation and army, fine-tune the details.

steps.title: 2. Pay the registration fee
steps.description: Within 10 days of registering you'll receive payment instructions. The booking becomes binding upon payment.

steps.title: 3. Confirmation
steps.description: After paying you'll get a summary. We send the final instructions and camp GPS to registered participants before the event.

steps.title: 4. Arrive at the venue
steps.description: On arrival you'll go through a safety check, a short briefing and registration into your army's camp.

items: The main game / battle is from age 12. For younger participants there is a separate children's game.
Participants under 18 need a signed consent of the legal guardian; under 15 only when accompanied by a person aged 18+.
The participant agrees to the rules and safety instructions.
Your LARP weapon and costume must pass an on-site check.
Cancellation, registration transfer and force majeure are governed by the separate Participation and registration terms.

payment.what_h3: What do I get for the registration fee
payment.what_p: Mainly **the game itself**. The costs include securing and renting the site, transport of props and equipment, printing of rules, quests and maps, light refreshments (a sweet breakfast, a Saturday snack), making new and repairing old props, medical material and other necessities.
payment.rates_intro: The amount of the registration fee depends on the type of participation and when you pay. The earlier you sign up and pay, the more you help us prepare the event.

footnotes: ** If the registration fee is an obstacle for you, get in touch — When the registration fee is a problem.
* We want to motivate you a little to share rides and cars.
** If you want to bring an animal companion to the camp, let us know in advance (by e-mail). It may happen that we cannot accept your animal in the camp.

payment.details_h3: Further details on the registration fee
details_items: **First price period** 18 May – 30 Jun 2026 = first-minute promotion. For combatants **850 CZK**, for participants from Slovakia and abroad **±€36.20**.
**Second price period** 1 Jul – 17 Aug 2026. For combatants **950 CZK**, from abroad **±€40.40**.
**Late registration** from 18 Aug 2026 and when paying on site. For combatants **1,100 CZK**, from abroad **±€46.80**.

For **non-playing and non-combat companions** (atmospheric characters, banner-bearers, photographers, fighter companions): **650 CZK / ±€27.60** until 30 Jun, **750 CZK / ±€31.90** from 1 Jul to 17 Aug, **950 CZK / ±€40.40** from 18 Aug and on site.
*Note:* If you register e.g. on 28 Jun but send the payment only on 5 Jul — the higher registration fee already applies for you.
*Note:* The registration fee in euros is converted at the current exchange rate. Prices may differ slightly and may be affected by your bank's fee.
kids_items: **Children up to 4 years** (inclusive) do not pay any registration fee but must be registered via Registračka as „associated persons" within the non-playing category.
**Children from 5 to 12 years** get a discount — **400 CZK / €17** as participants outside the children's game.
**Children from 5 to 12 years** can also take part in the children's game. The registration is then **600 CZK / €25.50**. The children's game requires standard sign-up via the registration form.
**Children from 12 years** (inclusive) are considered regular participants. The main game is 12+. The above basic fees apply to them.
family_items: Maximum family registration fee from 18 May to 30 Jun 2026: **2,500 CZK / €106.40**.
Maximum family registration fee from 1 Jul to 17 Aug 2026: **2,750 CZK / €117.00**.
Maximum family registration fee from 18 Aug and when paying on site: **2,900 CZK / €123.40**.
The family rate applies to **two adults and all their offspring** registered together under one Registračka account as „associated persons".
The family rate is set as a **maximum**. If the sum of regular registrations is lower, the lower amount applies.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.body: **2 adult combatants**, **1 of their offspring aged 14** as a combatant and **10 more offspring under 12** are coming to PP — the family will pay at most **2,500 CZK** (until 30 Jun).

examples.label: Example 2
examples.body: **1 adult as a combatant**, **1 adult as non-playing** and **1 offspring aged 7** are coming to PP — the family will pay **850 + 650 + 400 = 1,900 CZK** (until 30 Jun). Below the family maximum, so this lower amount applies.

how_pay_items: You'll receive payment instructions by e-mail right after registration.
You can pay by **QR code** or **bank transfer**.
The registration fee must be paid **within 10 days of registering**.
If you feel that you have paid and the registration still doesn't show as paid, write to us and attach proof of payment.
payment.cancel_h3: Cancellation, registration transfer and force majeure
cancel_paragraphs: **Cancellation:** until **30 June 2026** we refund **100 %** of the amount paid, from **1 July to 31 July 2026** we refund **50 %**, from **1 August 2026** the registration fee is non-refundable. The decisive date is when the cancellation request is delivered to info@panprstenu.cz.

**Transfer to a substitute** is possible at any time up to the start of the event and is free of charge — write us an e-mail that you cannot come and state the variable symbol (payment reference) of the player you are passing the fee to. We will remove you and reassign the payment. Any financial settlement takes place between the two of you.
When you know you cannot come, write to us as soon as possible. The sooner we know, the greater the chance of finding a fair solution.
The full wording including the settlement rules is in the Participation and registration terms.
payment.force_majeure_h3: When something happens beyond our control
payment.force_majeure_p: The event takes place outdoors and in a natural environment. If we had to change, postpone or cancel the event for safety or organisational reasons, we will inform you by e-mail and via the website. We will always try to find the fairest possible solution depending on what already had to be paid and what can still be returned. Details in the Participation terms.

gdpr.p1: Consent to the processing of personal data is required for participation and use of the registration system. **Registračka.cz** is a registration system operated by the **Moravian LARP, z. s.** association. Data from a particular event is available only to people who actually need it for that event.
gdpr.alert_body: Thanks to the registration we can plan the playing area, quest length, administration, venue rentals and other things. In short: without registration we cannot prepare a good game.
